g.text: Timing: mean across selected views per job → median across job means; whiskers = job-mean min/max (not CI). Speedup = ratio of medians.
Forward uses training autograd; no inference timings shown. Quality: minimum PSNR / maximum gradient error and repeat noise across views.
MP = width × height / 1e6. Infinite PSNR is displayed at 120 dB only (∞ label); finite PSNR is not clipped. Lines connect measured points only.
